room.hall.title: Stone Hall
room.hall.description: A bare hall of grey stone. A doorway opens east; a door leads north to the garden.
room.dart_room.title: Dart Corridor
room.dart_room.description: A narrow corridor. Small holes line the walls at chest height.
narration.poison.applied: A dart pricks your arm. Cold spreads from the wound.
narration.poison.tick: The poison burns in your veins.
narration.poison.expired: The poison fades from your blood.
room.garden.title: Garden
room.garden.description: Beds of leeks and a bench. The hall door is south.
npc.maud.description: Maud keeps the hall by day and her garden by evening.
